name: Great Living Chola Temples
description: In Tamil Nadu, southern India, three Hindu temples built by the Chola kings in the 11th and 12th centuries are still used for worship today. At Gangaikondacholisvaram, finished in 1035, a 53-metre sanctum tower rises in gently curving tiers, softer than the severe tower at Thanjavur. At Darasuram, a smaller 24-metre tower stands in a complex rich in sculpture.
